about: Calendar times around the America/Toronto clock changes of 2027 (forward on Sunday 2027-03-14 at 2:00, back on Sunday 2027-11-07 at 2:00). Read by the Vitest calendar specs and the RSpec request specs, so the browser and the server are checked against the same table. A field is a datetime-local value in Toronto wall-clock time; an instant is UTC.

fieldToInstant.label: midnight starting the day the clocks go forward
just before the clocks go forward
a time skipped when the clocks go forward (the same instant as 3:30)
midnight after the clocks went forward
a time in the repeated hour when the clocks go back (the first one)
late evening (already the next day in UTC)
early morning (still the day before in Tokyo)

instantToField.label: the first instant after the clocks go forward
the first 1:30 when the clocks go back
the second 1:30 when the clocks go back
late evening (already the next day in UTC)

calendarStrings.label: a one-off event in winter (the feed gives an offset)
an occurrence of a repeating event in summer (no zone: Toronto wall-clock time)
an occurrence on the day the clocks go forward
a late-evening occurrence (already the next day in UTC)
an occurrence at the first 1:30 when the clocks go back
a one-off event at the second 1:30 when the clocks go back

untilDates.label: the day the clocks go forward (it ends in summer time)
the day before the clocks go back
the day the clocks go back (it ends in winter time)
